spans.s:
The affix छ also comes in the sense of 'this its deity' after the names 1. द्यावा 2. पृथिवी 3. शुनासीर 4. मरुत्वद् 5. अग्निषोम 6. वास्तोष्पति 7. गृहमेधा।

Terms: छ

Short इ is substituted for the final of 1. दो 2. सो 3. मा and 4. स्था before an affix beginning with त् and having an indicatory क् ।

Terms: इ substitution
